spans.s:
पैतदारव पैतदारव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीत-
दारु), see Gaṇa to Pāṇ.

पैतापुत्रीय पैतापुत्रीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-
पुत्र), relating to father and son.

पैतामहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-मह), be-
longing or relating to a grandfather.

पैतृक पैतृक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belong-
ing or relating to a father or to ancestors generally,
coming or derived from a father, paternal, ancestral;
belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred to the
Manes; (अम्), n. a sacred rite or Śrāddha in honour
of the Manes or deceased ancestors.
—पैतृक-
धन, अम्, n. ancestral property, patrimony.
—पै-
तृक-भूमि, इस्, f. the country of one's ancestors,
fatherland; a paternal estate.

पैतृमत्य, अस्, m. (fr. पितृ-मत्), sprung
from one who has an illustrious father, the grandson
of an illustrious man.

पैतृयज्ञिक, Ved. or पैतृयज्ञीय, अस्, ई,
अम् (fr. पितृ-यज्ञ), belonging or relating to a
sacrifice to the Manes.

पैतृष्वसेय or पैतृष्वस्रीय, अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. पितृ-ष्वसृ), sprung from a father's sister
or paternal aunt; (अस्), m. a father's sister's son,
the son of a paternal aunt; (ई), f. a father's sister's
daughter, the daughter of a paternal aunt (see Manu

पैत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-
lating to a father or to ancestors generally, paternal,
ancestral; belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred
or consecrated to the Manes; (अम्), n. the part of
the hand between the thumb and fore-finger, (ac-
cording to others) the root of the fore-finger [cf.
पितृ-तीर्थ]; a year or month or day of the
Pitṛs.
—पैत्राहोरात्र (˚र-अह्˚), अस्, m. a day and
night of the Pitṛs or progenitors (= one month).

पैत्रिक = पैतृक (for which it is probably an
incorrect form).

पैत्र्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-
lating to the Manes.

पैत्त पैत्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्त), relating to
the bilious humor, proceeding from bile, bilious.

पैत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bilious, of a bilious tem-
perament.

पैत्तल पैत्तल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्तल), made
of brass, brazen.
